verdict.rationale: W&B publishes an official MCP server (dedicated docs page plus the wandb/wandb-mcp-server GitHub repo). It gives IDEs, coding assistants, and chat agents such as Claude Code direct access to Weave traces, evaluations, runs, and artifacts, and docs describe pairing it with W&B Skills for autonomous iteration loops. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's Weave tooling, and detail on which actions (e.g., running evaluations) come from the MCP server itself rather than from Skills.
